description: Verbatim selected test diffs, production diffs and command outputs recovered from the original 2026-10-11 implementation session after R6 review. This supplements, and does not replace or redate, T081-tests-first.json.

source.extraction: Events are selected by one-based JSONL line. Each line hash covers its original raw bytes, including the terminating newline. FileChange unified_diff and CommandExecution command, exit_code and aggregated_output are copied without redaction. Repository paths are normalized relative to the implementation root.

limits: No per-run staged patch or full source hash was captured alongside these historical command events. The event ordering and raw line hashes support chronology, but cannot cryptographically bind each run to an exact complete source tree.
Early CRLF fixture setup failures preceded the included CRLF assertion failure and are not presented as production regression reds.
The builder red exercises the shared verifier builder selection that also affected Tor rollback loopback reachability; there is no separate historical pre-fix runtime Tor rollback red.
The later Tor loopback probe is post-fix compatibility evidence only. Its first harness attempt failed from an overbroad grep matching Dockerfile text, and is not a product red.
Recovered R1/R2 events are not inserted into the original tests-first red or superseded history. An independent reviewer must determine whether this record meets Principle VII.

tor_rollback_post_fix.shared_cause: Before the builder fix, the complete verifier inherited a private docker-container builder. The verifier-created image was not available to the local daemon for docker create/run, and the isolated builder could not reach the runner host-loopback rollback replay proxy. The builder red in this record detects the inherited builder selection; it does not itself execute the Tor rollback path.

first_probe.failure_class: probe harness overbroad grep matched Dockerfile text; not a Tor rollback runtime red

corrected_probe.observation: The host-loopback replay proxy received /rollback; the build emitted a runtime pinned-index-hash rejection. Repeating with the proxy closed gave connection refusal and no runtime hash-rejection marker.
